headlines.title: JPMorgan says AI stock selling may be nearing its limit as positioning resets
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan told clients in a new note that recent selling in AI-related stocks may be nearing its limit, with the bank pointing to signs that equity positioning has reset significantly since mid-September.

headlines.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for Institutional Payments
headlines.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) has extended its JPM Coin payment system to the Ethereum mainnet for institutional clients. The bank is moving its USD-backed deposit token beyond private, permissioned ledgers to a widely used public blockchain network. Institutional users can now send on-chain dollar transfers using JPM Coin over Ethereum, aiming for faster settlement and 24/7 availability.

headlines.title: ManpowerGroup to Participate in J.P. Morgan Ultimate Services Investor Conference
headlines.summary: ManpowerGroup (NYSE: MAN) today announced that Jack McGinnis, Chief Financial Officer, and Becky Frankiewicz, President and Chief Strategy Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the J.P. Morgan Ultimate Services Investor Conference in New York City on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, from 1:20 PM – 1:50 PM EST.

headlines.title: The simple reason JPMorgan thinks SpaceX will triple: It's going after a $28 trillion market
headlines.summary: Analyst Doug Anmuth raised his price target from $240 to $500, making the bull case for SpaceX.

headlines.title: Watsco Completes $750 Million Unsecured Senior Credit Facility
headlines.summary: MIAMI, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Watsco, Inc. (NYSE: WSO) today announced that it has signed a $750 million unsecured senior revolving credit facility led by Bank of America, N.A. as Joint Lead Arranger, Sole Bookrunner and Administrative Agent and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., PNC Bank, N.A., Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., and U.S. Bank N.A. as Joint Lead Arrangers and Co-Syndication Agents, along with five other banks.

description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. operates as a bank and financial holding company in the United States, rest of North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Caribbean. It operates in three segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management. The company offers deposit, investment and lending products, and cash management; mortgage origination and servicing activities; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and credit cards, payment solutions, travel services, merchant offers, lifestyle benefits, auto loans, and leases to consumers and small businesses through bank branches, ATMs, and digital and telephone banking. It also provides investment banking, market-making, financing, custody, and securities products and services; corporate strategy and structure advisory, equity and debt market capital-raising, and loan origination and syndication services; cash and derivative instruments, risk management solutions, prime brokerage, clearing, and research; and fund services, liquidity and trading services, and data solutions products for large corporations, financial institutions, merchants, start-ups, small and midsized companies, local governments, municipalities, nonprofits, and commercial real estate clients. In addition, the company offers multi-asset investment management solutions in equities, fixed income, alternatives, and money market funds to institutional clients and retail investors; retirement products and services, estate planning, lending, deposits, and investment management products to high-net-worth clients; and financial transaction processing. JPMorgan Chase & Co. was founded in 1799 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
